root: ^Two knights stand at the entrance to the capital tower, clad in armor but clearly more interested in their conversation than actual guarding.
^"Do you ever think about how we all wear the same helmet and armor?"
^"I mean, how do people tell us apart?"
^"No, no—think about it. We all look the same in this armor. It's like we have no individuality!"
^"You think the captain would allow that?"
^The other knight chuckles as he begins to say his next words.
^"No, but I would love to see you try."
